name: PRL-8-53
summary: A nootropic research chemical first synthesized in the 1970's. There is a single clinical study showing drastic improvement in mid-term memory among users, but otherwise it is severely under researched and caution should be given to any singular study. The reportedly does not have recreational value.
advisory: It is strongly recommend to start with low dosages and increase slowly.
doseBasis: NOTE: It is strongly recommend to start with low dosages and increase slowly.

pharmacology.text: The exact mechanism of action of PRL-8-53 remains unknown.

summaryZh: PRL-8-53是一種促智的苯乙胺衍生物，已被證明為一種可用於人體的增強記憶的藥物。最早是由克雷頓大學的醫學化學教授Nikolaus Hansl於20世紀70年代合成。
summaryZhHans: PRL-8-53是一种促智的苯乙胺衍生物，已被证明为一种可用于人体的增强记忆的药物。最早是由克雷顿大学的医学化学教授Nikolaus Hansl于20世纪70年代合成。

uses.en: It is sold online as a nootropic, with claims that it improves memory. These claims rest on a single small human study, and it is not an approved medicine.
uses.zh: 它在網路上被當作益智藥販售，聲稱能改善記憶。這些說法只依據一項小型人體研究，它並不是核准的藥物。
uses.zhHans: 它在网络上被当作益智药贩售，声称能改善记忆。这些说法只依据一项小型人体研究，它并不是核准的药物。

fact.en: PRL-8-53 was first made in the 1970s by the chemist Nikolaus Hansl at Creighton University in Nebraska, who also ran the only published human study of it.
fact.zh: PRL-8-53 於 1970 年代由內布拉斯加州克雷頓大學的化學家 Nikolaus Hansl 首次合成，他也主持了唯一一項已發表的人體研究。
fact.zhHans: PRL-8-53 于 1970 年代由内布拉斯加州克雷顿大学的化学家 Nikolaus Hansl 首次合成，他也主持了唯一一项已发表的人体研究。
